content.snl: def-struct-hyp(Type.judge(@F,Type.to(Type,Type)),Type.contravariant(F),struct[enumerate](member[colon](%map%,%for every f : A → B, a map F(f) : F(B) → F(A)% ),member[colon](%identity law%,%F(id_A)=id_{F(A)}%),member[colon](%reversed composition law%,%F(g ∘ f)=F(f) ∘ F(g)%)))

values.en: A contravariant functor sends f : A → B to F(f) : F(B) → F(A), reversing the direction of arrows and the order of composition. In positivity calculations, a contravariant type constructor reverses polarity.
values.zh-CN: 反变（逆变）函子把 f : A → B 映为 F(f) : F(B) → F(A)，反转箭头方向与复合次序。在正性计算中，反变类型构造子会反转极性。
